channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brandon Miller | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brandon Miller from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Naz Reid on Brandon Miller, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
Naz Reid on Brandon Miller:

“His patience. His consistency. I think his leadership is starting to kinda form, and that’s big in a younger guy. I was with Ant [Edwards], who I started to see his shift and his change of going from his third year to his fourth year, and I think Brandon can do the same. I think I’m coming here to help out. This is his team, him and Kon [Knueppel], and I’m here to help in a big way. But I think the growth for him would be to, like I said, lead on and off the court and just be consistent and do the things that you preach.”

Naz Reid on Brandon Miller, Anthony Edwards, Oct 5, 2026. Source: TalkBasket.

item.title: Jeff Peterson on Brandon Miller
item.description:
Hornets executive Jeff Peterson on Brandon Miller extension talks:

“I’ve had conversations with Brandon and his representation. They know that we want Brandon here for a very long time. I won’t get into particulars. Bottom line is we want Brandon Miller here for a very long time”

Jeff Peterson on Brandon Miller, Jul 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Charles Lee on Brandon Miller
item.description:
“I think it was just shoulder soreness, and he’ll be evaluated.“ Lee said he never saw the actual point when Miller got injured. “I really didn’t, to be honest,”

Charles Lee on Brandon Miller, Oct 26, 2025. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Gordon Hayward, Brandon Miller
item.description:
“Brandon did some light, light shooting this morning. You could tell he wasn’t able to go through walk-through. The thing with Gordon, this has been going on for two or three games where he’s played his way through it and then it got a little bit worse in New York. “His is a hamstring, so that could be four to six weeks, so you can’t mess with that. We need him. We need them both. They’re pretty good defenders and so hopefully we’ll have them by Friday. I don’t think either one is a serious injury.”

Steve Clifford on Gordon Hayward, Brandon Miller, Nov 15, 2023. Source: Charlotte Observer.
